data.body:
[P2] Keep invocation-end status consistent with the wrapper outcome

For a small successful result, no terminal checkpoint is sent. If an `on_invocation_end` hook consumes the remaining budget, this check raises `InvocationDeadlineExceeded` after every End hook has already received `SUCCEEDED`. Both bundled OTel plugins export the terminal workflow span before calling `force_flush()`, so a slow flush causes Lambda to retry an execution already reported as finished. Finalize the outcome before reporting terminal status to plugins—for example, acknowledge the terminal result before End so it survives subsequent cleanup—and add a slow-End integration test asserting both wrapper and telemetry outcomes.
